args: Analyze the root cause and best in-tree validation/error-handling pattern for _dwarf_internal_read_rnglists_header in libdwarf/src/lib/libdwarf/dwarf_rnglists.c. Specifically, how should the encoded unit payload length be checked while accounting for its 4/12-byte initial-length encoding, and how should the offset_entry_count table multiplication/range be validated against both unit end and section end? Identify similar parsers and suitable existing error codes/macros.

The sanitizer report shows a 4-byte heap-buffer-overflow in dwarf_get_rnglist_offset_index_value at dwarf_rnglists.c around line 533 after fuzz_rng loads a malformed DWARF5 .debug_rnglists section. The parser currently validates arealen against the entire section even though arealen excludes the initial length encoding, then derives rc_length and rc_endaddr beyond allocation. It also multiplies offset_size by offset_entry_count and advances the offset table without complete overflow and bounds checks. No edits have yet been made; I need a minimal source-only fix under libdwarf that rejects malformed units at parse time and follows existing libdwarf conventions.
